name: Penny's mother
text_excerpt: Penny's mother (née Milton) was an unseen character who gave birth to Penelope, the daughter of Charles Widmore, some time before the mid-1970s at the latest. Charles left the Island regularly and carried on a relationship with Penny's mother during his tenure as Leader of the Others. This interaction with an "outsider" broke the rules that bound the group. Sometime in the 1990s, the Others discovered Charles's transgressions and banished him from the Island. Ben Linus replaced him as the Others' leader. In the flash sideways world, Penny's name was "Penny Milton," while her half-brother Daniel Faraday's name was "Daniel Widmore".
